verdict.rationale: Bench runs several background automations once accounts are connected: transaction feeds flow in automatically (bench-docs-15, bench-docs-24, bench-docs-28), categorization rules are generated from business patterns (bench-docs-17, bench-docs-25), and merchant-fee reconciliation is automatic (bench-docs-27). These automations are vendor-defined and paired with a human bookkeeper (bench-supp-model); the user's only setup step is connecting accounts, not authoring their own automations. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation or workflow builder, user-defined triggers, rules or schedules, any API or agent hooks for custom automations (OpenAPI probes return 404), independent corroboration.
